     "content": "In the continuation of the show, Filip plays a video address by Dr. Alma Demirović, representative of Hrvatska udruga roditelja aktivista (HURA), who presented shocking data obtained through official channels from the Agency for Medicinal Products and Medical Devices (HALMED). Instead of independent laboratory quality testing, the agency carries out exclusively administrative verification of papers and certificates issued by foreign laboratories within the European Union.
